summary: Institutional positioning is heavily skewed toward long-term bullishness on the broad market, evidenced by massive $1.5B+ accumulations in SPX 7000C (Dec 2027) and $1.3B+ in SPX 7000C (Sept 2026). While heavy put buying is visible in ORCL, GLD, and QQQ, the dominant conviction lies in multi-day, persistent accumulation of SPX 7000C strikes exceeding $5B over the last four sessions. Traders should watch for volatility around SPX levels as the massive $8000P (2026/2027) hedges suggest institutions are simultaneously building long-dated tail-risk protection against a significant market reversal. Monitor META and NDX for continued strength, as their extremely low P/C ratios (0.13 and 0.16) indicate aggressive, one-sided call buying.
